visualCharacteristics: Two-column hero: text content (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, CTA button) on the left, an embedded product video framed on the right. Stacks to a single column on narrow viewports.
contentPattern: One row with two cells. Left cell: eyebrow line, heading, paragraph, and a CTA link. Right cell: a link to an .mp4 video (rendered as an HTML5 video player).
usage: Use for an introductory hero that pairs a headline and call-to-action with a product demo video.
